يستثمر (form X)
# يَسْتَثْمِرُ (yastaṯmiru) /jas.taθ.mi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# يُسْتَثْمَرُ (yustaṯmaru) /jus.taθ.ma.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# يَسْتَثْمِرَ (yastaṯmira) /jas.taθ.mi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَثْمَر
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
